Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"Dingo D. Dog" <bl...@mail.net> wrote in message
news:a6g8k5$8ph$1...@dinkel.civ.utwente.nl...

> Is there any card that is useable by Sabbat Vampires that has a similar
> effect as the 5th tradition ?
>
> Sander

(Un?)fortunately, not really. The Sabbat titled-minion cards tend to lean
towards permenants that give a vampire an ability. Blood of the Sabbat,
Eternal Vigilance, Blood Siege, Concecration Rites etc.

This makes Sabbat bloat decks a bit tricky but they also have access to a
few nice cards that can be used by all your minions rather than relying on a
minion with certain text.

I mean, how much better is Hungry Coyote than Inbase Discotek!

>Is there any card that is useable by Sabbat Vampires that has a similar

Depends on what you have in mind. For blood gain, the Sabbat counterpart to
the Camarilla's 5th Tradition + Minion Tap combo would be Blood Feast + Tribute
to the Master.

-- John Whelan

I'm actually starting to prefer this kind of combo. It requires smaller
minions and you can make versions that don't require any fat minions at all.
( TTM + Media Influence/Patshiv ). It also means that if you fail to fill
your guys up it isn't as bad as failing to 5th or whatever.
